title: Will fJscaler's 100GHz BiCMOS TIA Change Optical Links in AI Data Centers?
excerpt: An explanation of fJscaler's sample shipments of its 100GHz BiCMOS TIA. This beginner-friendly article covers what a TIA does, what 0.85 pJ/bit and 1.6T optical links mean, the technology's limits, and what to check next.
